text:
aj: quick q — where do people keep short log snippets for org/model/route troubleshooting? I need examples for a canary eval and an alert tuneup.

maria: we keep a handful in the log snippets doc, but for quick ops i usually paste the ones below. saving them as searches helps.

maria: per-org errors last 30m (group by route + status):
```
org_id:acme AND level:error AND route:/generate* AND model_name:mixtral*
| stats count() by route, status_code
| sort -count
```

maria: per-model latency distrib (p50/p95) in ms, last 1h:
```
model_name:mixtral* AND region:eu
| stats perc(latency_ms,50) as p50, perc(latency_ms,95) as p95 by model_name
```

maria: healthy-check filter to ignore /health and /metrics noise (use this in alerts):
```
NOT route:(/health OR /metrics) AND level:warning OR level:error
```

noah: nice, fyi for canary we also look at kv-cache-miss spikes. snippet:
```
org_id:acme AND event:kv_cache_miss AND timestamp:[now-15m TO now]
| timechart count()
```

sophie: linking the canary dashboard for reference: https://console.redwood.example/d/ops/canary-overview?org=acme 
(use the right time range + model filter)

cheng: for alerts, avoid firing on single route flaps — add a rate and fraction threshold. e.g. alert if error_rate > 0.01 AND errors >= 20 over 10m.

aj: thanks — does anyone have a saved search name i can point paging alerts at?

sre-bot: saved search created by maria: "canary-eval/acme-errors-30m" (id: ss-20240321-7)

maria: ^ that's the one i used above. i also added a variant that excludes health checks: "canary-eval/acme-errors-30m-nohealth"

noah: quick note — if you filter by region remember model_name sometimes has a suffix for quantized variants, use wildcard `model_name:mixtral*`

aj: perfect. i'll wire the alert to the saved search and ping when i push the tuning change. cc @sophie for dashboard link. :thumbsup:

maria: 👍 also adding these snippets to the ops snippets doc so we have a canonical copy.

aj: done — thanks all.
